ui.times.intro: Say when you can train: how long and at what time. A day without a time is a rest day.

ui.load.title: Your training plan
ui.load.intro: Your coach makes the plan in Tröskel and sends it as a link, a QR code or a file. Open the link on the phone and the plan lands here.
ui.load.error.not_a_plan: That is not a plan from Tröskel.
ui.load.error.too_new: The plan was made in a newer version of Tröskel. Update the app.
ui.load.error.broken: The plan could not be read. Ask your coach to send it again.
ui.qr.title: Point the camera at the QR code
ui.qr.no_camera: The camera could not start. Open the link or the file instead.
ui.demo.banner: This is an example, not your plan.
ui.about.title: About
ui.about.privacy: The app sends no data anywhere. The plan and your times are kept on this device only. The link from your coach carries the plan itself, after the #, and that part is never sent to a server.
ui.about.delete: Delete all data on this device
ui.about.delete_confirm: Delete the plan and your times from this device?

ui.offline: The app works offline once it has been opened.
